limits: Compares decoded pixel samples of the two given files only; it does not re-render any page, DOM, or application.
Byte-level differences (PNG compression, chunk order, metadata/tEXt/timestamps, EXIF) are deliberately ignored and are NOT rendering diffs.
A pass means the two files decode to the same pixel matrix. It is not evidence that either image is correct, current, or the intended output.
A pass does not establish that the real rendering pipeline is deterministic; it only characterizes these two artifacts.
Decoder-dependent behavior (color profiles, gamma chunks, 16-bit downconversion, palette/alpha normalization) can affect the comparison; HDR/ICC transforms and interlaced edge cases are not covered.
No tolerance is applied: any single differing channel sample fails the exact check (use the reported delta statistics to judge near-matches).
